headline: Saudi oil pipeline hit in strikes will be mostly out of service for several weeks for repair

predictions.mechanism: A multi-week outage of a major Saudi export bypass keeps oil elevated, reinforces inflation pressure and weighs on broad equity risk appetite.
predictions.invalidation: A rapid restart of most pipeline capacity or a sharp reversal lower in oil prices.

predictions.mechanism: Higher oil-driven inflation and elevated Treasury yields increase pressure on duration-sensitive technology valuations.
predictions.invalidation: Oil and Treasury yields fall sharply or risk sentiment reverses.

predictions.mechanism: Europe is highly sensitive to energy-price inflation and tighter-rate expectations from a prolonged oil supply disruption.
predictions.invalidation: Oil prices reverse lower materially or pipeline capacity returns faster than expected.

predictions.mechanism: A prolonged Saudi export constraint raises energy and inflation risk for European equities.
predictions.invalidation: Oil prices reverse lower materially or the outage proves much shorter than reported.

predictions.mechanism: Escalating geopolitical and energy-supply risk can support safe-haven demand for gold.
predictions.invalidation: Stronger USD and higher yields dominate safe-haven demand or geopolitical risk de-escalates.
